description: Get the ranking of frontier AI models for one profession: the best result, the runner-up, the best value and the best open-weights model, the full table with data coverage and price, which tasks each benchmark measures and which tasks no benchmark measures yet. Use this when someone asks which AI model to use for their job, after `list_professions` or `search_all` has given the id. When `evaluation.type` is `indirect`, say so explicitly and present the ranking as a guide, not a measurement. Cite `canonical_url` with `dataset_version`.

id.description: Profession id from list_professions (e.g. 'lawyer', 'translator'), or its name in English or Spanish.

limit.description: Rows of the full table to return (default: all).

locale.description: Language of names, tasks and caveats. The benchmarks site publishes en and es; other locales fall back to English.

name: recommend_model_for_profession

dimensions_not_measured.description: What no benchmark evaluates at all — independent of task coverage.

how_to_present.description: Follow this when quoting the limits: it says which of the two axes is complete and which is not.
Follow this when quoting the ranking.

not_measured.description: Dimensions no benchmark in the catalogue evaluates at all. A different axis from `unmeasured_tasks`, which is about this profession's listed tasks; this one applies even when that list is empty.

unmeasured_tasks.description: The listed tasks with no benchmark behind them. An empty list means every task is covered, not that the ranking measures everything that matters — see `coverage`.

title: Which AI model is best for a profession
